runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-pip && printf '[global]\nbreak-system-packages = true\n' > /etc/pip.conf && python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'pytest>=9.0.3' 'setuptools>=77.0' 'click>=5.0' ipython && /usr/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'pytest>=9.0.3' 'setuptools>=77.0' 'click>=5.0' ipython && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
runner.env_probe_command: PYTHONPATH=src /usr/bin/python3 -c "from io import StringIO; import os, envfile, click; assert os.path.realpath(envfile.__file__).startswith(os.path.realpath('src')); os.environ.pop('CB_PROBE', None); assert envfile.load_envfile(stream=StringIO('CB_PROBE=from_stream\n')); assert os.environ.get('CB_PROBE') == 'from_stream'" && printf 'CB_PROBE=from_cli\n' > /tmp/cb-env-probe.env && PYTHONPATH=src /usr/bin/python3 -m envfile -f /tmp/cb-env-probe.env get CB_PROBE | grep -qx from_cli && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import click, envfile"

init_metadata.tech_stack: Pure Python environment-file loader (setuptools src layout, pytest, optional CLI extra); CPU-only
